$comment: An entry the host loads into an iframe instead of importing as a module. Derived from the base entry type rather than from entry_mf.v1~, which is the whole mechanism: handler resolution is prefix matching, so MfeHandlerMF never matches this type and the two loaders never compete. The entry carries no address — only the id of the shared property one arrives in — so the loader learns nothing about Theia, sessions, or whoever writes that property. See docs/adr/0021-an-mfe-entry-may-be-a-frame.md.

urlProperty.$comment: The id of the shared property carrying the frame's address. Must also appear in this entry's requiredProperties, and therefore in the domain's sharedProperties, or registration fails contract validation.
